enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan on for air circulation, respecting quiet hours
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Press the fan switch to turn it on. Turn the fan dial to the low setting. Press the light switch to turn off the bedroom light. Close eyes. Remain lying on the back. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Adjust the pillow under the head. Remain lying still. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket back up. Stretch the legs out. Remain lying with eyes closed. Sleep through the night without leaving the room. Keep the bedroom door closed. Leave the fan running continuously until morning.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and getting ready for the clinical placement day (Bathroom is free after Member 2 finishes at 06:30)
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Press the fan switch to turn the fan off. Walk to the bathroom door. Open the door. Step inside. Press the light switch to turn the light on. Turn the shower tap to the hot position. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub soap over the body. Rinse the body. Turn the shower tap off. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the hook. Rub the towel over the hair. Dry the body with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the tap. Turn the tap off. Wipe the face with the towel. Press the light switch to turn the light off. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and making a thermos of tea for the day (using the kitchen after Member 1 and Member 2 have cleared their breakfast space)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the kitchen light switch on. Open the cupboard door. Take out the box of oats. Set the box on the bench. Open the box. Pour oats into a bowl. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Close the refrigerator door. Pour milk over the oats. Open the cutlery drawer. Take out a spoon. Close the drawer. Stir the oats with the spoon. Sit down at the kitchen table. Lift the spoon. Eat the bowl of oats. Pick up the empty bowl. Stand up. Walk to the sink. Rinse the bowl under the tap. Place the bowl in the dish rack. Fill the kettle with water. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard. Take out the thermos. Unscrew the thermos lid. Place a teabag into the thermos. Wait for the kettle to boil. Press the kettle switch off. Pour hot water into the thermos. Screw the thermos lid back on. Pick up the thermos. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing clinical placement notes and packing nursing uniform, ID badge and study bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 3. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the folded nursing uniform. Lay the uniform flat on the bed. Open the drawer. Take out the closed shoes. Set the shoes on the floor beside the bed. Take out the socks. Place the socks on top of the uniform. Walk to the desk. Pick up the printed clinical placement notes. Sit down on the chair. Read through the notes page by page. Turn each page with the right hand. Close the notes folder. Stand up. Walk to the hook on the wall. Take the ID badge and lanyard off the hook. Drop the ID badge into the bag front pocket. Open the study bag. Place the notes folder into the bag. Place the pen into the bag side pocket. Zip the bag closed. Pick up the uniform and socks. Place them into the bag. Pick up the bag. Place the bag beside the bedroom door. Pick up the thermos from the desk. Place the thermos into the bag side pocket. Press the light switch to turn the light off. Pick up the bag. Open the bedroom door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport to the hospital clinical placement site
enriched_activities.desc: Walk down the driveway to the street. Carry the study bag on the right shoulder. Walk along the footpath to the bus stop. Stop at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the phone. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the phone on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on an empty seat. Place the bag on the lap. Look at the route stops on the screen. Stand up when the stop is called. Pick up the bag. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk to the train platform. Stand on the platform. Step onto the train. Tap the phone on the reader. Sit down. Place the bag beside the legs. Stand up at the station. Pick up the bag. Step off the train. Walk up the stairs out of the station. Walk along the footpath to the hospital entrance. Push the hospital entrance door open. Walk through. Stop at the reception area.

enriched_activities.activity: Nursing clinical placement: patient observations, medication rounds under supervision and documenting care
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the ward handover room. Sit down on a chair. Listen to the handover report. Write notes in the notebook with a pen. Stand up. Walk to the bedside of the first patient. Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the numbers on the screen. Write the numbers in the observation chart. Remove the cuff. Pick up the thermometer. Place the thermometer under the patient's tongue. Remove the thermometer. Read the temperature. Write the temperature in the chart. Pick up the pulse oximeter. Clip the oximeter onto the patient's finger. Read the oxygen saturation value. Write the value in the chart. Walk to the medication trolley. Pick up the medication cup. Check the label against the chart. Hand the cup to the supervising nurse. Walk with the nurse to the patient bed. Watch the nurse administer the medication. Sign the medication chart with a pen. Walk back to the nurses' station. Sit down. Enter the care notes on the computer. Type the patient details. Save the entry. Stand up. Walk to the next patient bed. Assist the patient to sit up in the bed. Pick up the water jug. Pour water into the cup. Hand the cup to the patient. Take the cup back. Place the cup on the bedside table. Straighten the bedsheet with both hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the placement site
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff break room. Sit down on a chair at the table. Open the study bag. Take out the lunch container. Open the container lid. Pick up the fork. Eat the lunch from the container. Pick up the thermos from the bag. Unscrew the thermos lid. Pour tea into the lid cup. Drink the tea. Screw the lid back on. Close the lunch container. Place the container back into the bag. Stand up. Walk to the sink. Rinse the fork under the tap. Place the fork in the bag. Walk back to the table. Sit down. Take the phone out. Read messages on the phone. Put the phone back into the pocket. Stand up. Walk out of the break room.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical placement duties, assisting with personal care and handover preparation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the patient bed. Pull the curtain around the bed closed. Assist the patient to turn onto the side. Pick up the washcloth. Wet the washcloth under the tap. Wipe the patient's back. Dry the back with a towel. Assist the patient to turn back. Pull the curtain open. Place the soiled linen into the laundry bag. Walk to the nurses' station. Sit down at the computer. Open the care documentation page. Type the care details into the record. Save the file. Pick up the phone on the desk. Call the kitchen to confirm the diet order. Hang up the phone. Stand up. Collect the observation charts from the folder. Walk to each bedside. Take the blood pressure of the next patient. Write the readings in the chart. Take the temperature. Write the reading. Walk back to the nurses' station. Place the charts in the folder. Sit down. Open the handover template on the computer. Type the summary of the shift. Stand up. Walk to the handover room. Sit down. Read the written handover notes aloud to the supervising nurse. Answer the nurse's questions. Stand up. Walk to the staff room. Open the locker. Take out the bag. Close the locker. Walk out of the ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by public transport after placement
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the hospital entrance. Walk along the footpath to the train station. Walk up the stairs to the platform. Stand on the platform. Take the phone out. Check the train time on the phone. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the train. Tap the phone on the reader. Sit down on an empty seat. Place the bag on the lap. Open the bag. Take out the clinical notes. Read the notes. Put the notes back into the bag. Stand up at the station. Pick up the bag. Step off the train. Walk down the stairs. Walk to the bus stop. Step onto the bus. Tap the phone on the reader. Sit down. Place the bag between the legs. Stand up at the stop. Pick up the bag. Step off the bus. Walk along the footpath to the house. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a simple dinner using the induction cooker and microwave right after arriving home, cooking before Member 2's 17:30-18:30 cooking slot and the shared 18:00 dinner period
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen carrying the bag. Set the bag down on the floor beside the door. Press the kitchen light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the container of rice. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the bench. Open the cupboard. Take out the frying pan. Set the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button on. Press the heat setting button. Pour oil into the pan. Pick up the knife from the knife block. Cut the vegetables on the chopping board. Slide the cut vegetables into the pan. Stir the vegetables with a spatula. Pick up the rice container. Open the lid. Spoon the rice into a bowl. Place the bowl into the microwave. Close the microwave door. Press the microwave start button. Wait for the timer to beep. Press the microwave door button. Take the bowl out. Place the bowl on the bench. Press the induction cooker power button off. Slide the cooked vegetables onto the plate. Place the plate on the kitchen table. Pick up the chopping board. Rinse the board under the tap. Place the board in the dish rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of the clinical uniform after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 3. Open the bedroom door. Walk to the wardrobe. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the clean clothes. Lay the clothes on the bed. Walk to the bathroom door. Open the door. Step inside. Press the light switch on. Take off the uniform top. Place the uniform top into the laundry basket. Take off the uniform trousers. Place them into the laundry basket. Take off the socks. Place them into the laundry basket. Turn the shower tap to the hot position. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Rinse the body. Turn the shower tap off. Step out. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body. Hang the towel on the hook. Put on the clean clothes. Press the light switch off. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom. Walk to Bedroom 3. Close the bedroom door.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the kitchen table during the shared household dinner period, overlapping with Member 2's and Member 6's evening meals
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of Bedroom 3 to the kitchen. Carry the plate of food to the kitchen table. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the kitchen table. Place the phone beside the plate. Pick up the fork. Lift food from the plate. Eat the food. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Place the glass on the table. Say hello to Member 2 and Member 6 at the table. Continue eating with the fork. Pick up the water jug. Pour water into the glass. Place the jug on the table. Continue eating. Push the empty plate to the side. Stand up. Pick up the plate. Walk to the sink. Place the plate on the sink bench. Walk back to the table. Pick up the glass. Drink the remaining water. Place the glass on the sink bench. Wipe the table surface with a cloth. Return the cloth to the hook above the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the kitchen bench, leaving the shared space clean before Member 2 washes up at 19:15
enriched_activities.desc: Stand at the sink. Turn the tap on. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Pick up the plate. Wipe the plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the dish rack. Pick up the glass. Wipe the glass with the sponge. Rinse the glass. Place the glass in the dish rack. Pick up the fork. Wipe the fork. Rinse the fork. Place the fork in the dish rack. Turn the tap off. Pick up the cloth from the hook. Wipe the kitchen bench surface with the cloth. Wipe the stovetop surface with the cloth. Wipe the sink edge with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth out with both hands. Hang the cloth on the hook. Push the chair back under the kitchen table. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running a load of laundry in the washing machine (finishing before Member 2's 19:45 shower)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 3. Open the bedroom door. Walk to the laundry basket. Pick up the laundry basket with both hands. Carry the basket to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Step inside. Press the light switch on. Set the basket on the floor. Open the washing machine door. Pick up the uniform items from the basket. Place the items into the washing machine drum. Pick up the socks. Place them into the drum. Pick up the towels from the hook. Place the towels into the drum. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the program button to select the cycle. Press the start button. Wait for the drum to begin turning. Press the light switch off. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom. Carry the empty basket back to Bedroom 3. Place the basket on the floor. Close the bedroom door.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying Bachelor of Nursing coursework on the computer and writing up placement reflections under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Press the desk lamp switch on. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Wait for the screen to load. Type the password on the keyboard. Open the browser. Open the university course page. Click the lecture slides link. Read the slides on the screen. Scroll down the page with the mouse. Open the placement reflection template. Type the reflection text on the keyboard. Open the textbook. Turn to the chapter page. Read the chapter. Write notes in the notebook with a pen. Highlight sentences in the textbook with a highlighter. Close the textbook. Save the typed document with the keyboard shortcut. Open the email page. Attach the reflection document. Type the recipient address. Click send. Close the browser. Stand up. Walk to the bed. Pick up the phone. Sit down on the chair. Type messages on the phone. Place the phone on the desk. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a light snack and herbal tea and joining Member 1 at the kitchen table while he eats his pre-prepared flexitarian dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of Bedroom 3 to the kitchen. Press the kitchen light switch on. Open the cupboard door. Take out the herbal tea box. Take one tea bag from the box. Close the box. Place the tea bag into a mug. Fill the kettle with water. Press the kettle switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the snack container. Close the refrigerator door. Open the container lid. Place the snack onto a small plate. Wait for the kettle to boil. Press the kettle switch off. Pour hot water into the mug. Pick up the mug. Carry the mug and plate to the kitchen table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Say hello to Member 1 at the table. Pick up the snack from the plate. Eat the snack. Pick up the mug. Drink the tea. Set the mug on the table. Talk with Member 1 about the day's placement shift. Pick up the mug. Drink the rest of the tea. Stand up. Pick up the empty plate. Walk to the sink. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the dish rack. Place the mug in the dish rack. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, checking phone messages and setting an alarm for tomorrow
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 3. Close the bedroom door. Press the light switch on. Walk to the bed. Sit down on the edge of the bed. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the phone screen on. Open the messages app. Read the messages. Type replies on the phone keyboard. Open the clock app. Press the alarm tab. Set the alarm time for the morning. Press the save button. Place the phone on the bedside table. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Press the desk lamp switch off. Walk to the wardrobe. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the clothes for tomorrow. Lay the clothes on the chair. Close the wardrobe door. Walk to the bed. Sit down. Take off the slippers. Place the slippers beside the bed. Press the fan switch on. Turn the fan dial to the low setting. Press the light switch off. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the fan on for quiet, uninterrupted rest
enriched_activities.desc: Lie flat on the bed with eyes closed. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Adjust the pillow under the head. Turn onto the right side. Remain lying still. Turn onto the left side. Keep the fan running on the low setting. Keep the bedroom door closed. Stretch the legs out under the blanket. Remain lying with eyes closed. Turn onto the back. Pull the blanket back up over the chest. Remain lying without leaving the bed. Sleep through the night until the alarm.
